facts.fact: On 22 May 2024 Angola's Institute of Administrative Modernisation signed an MoU with the e-Governance Academy under which a Digital Governance Academy will be established to develop digital governance programmes for government employees.

systems.owner: Institute of Administrative Modernisation with e-Governance Academy

AGO.note: An interoperability platform is mentioned only as an attempt in a minister's speech.

facts.fact: The MoU says the planned Digital Governance Academy will also develop digital literacy programmes for citizen inclusion.

AGO.note: The e-Governance Academy is to help build a government cybersecurity framework; no government staff running systems are stated.
